statements.sql: UPDATE "Customer" AS "_r0" SET "checked" = TRUE, "points" = "_r0"."points" + $2 WHERE "_r0"."country" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $1

INSERT INTO "Archive" ("id", "country", "checked", "points") SELECT "id", "country", "checked", "points" FROM (SELECT * FROM "Customer" AS "_r1" WHERE "_r1"."country" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $1) AS "_r2"
